tracesTo: SOW: User Interactions - Content Creation & Engagement

stories.title: Create Basic Text Post
stories.goal: create a text-only post to share thoughts with the league
stories.benefit: I can express my opinions and engage with other members without needing external media
acceptanceCriteria: User can access a post creation interface from the newsfeed
User can enter text content with basic formatting (line breaks, paragraphs)
User can preview the post before publishing
User can publish the post, which immediately appears in the newsfeed
Post displays author name, role, team affiliation (if applicable), and timestamp

stories.title: Add Links to Posts
stories.goal: include external links in my posts to reference articles, videos, or other content
stories.benefit: I can support my arguments with external sources and share relevant content with the league
acceptanceCriteria: User can paste URLs into post content during creation
System automatically detects and converts URLs to clickable links
Links open in new browser tabs when clicked
Links display with appropriate styling to distinguish them from regular text
Links are validated to prevent malicious URLs

stories.title: Format Post Text
stories.goal: apply basic text formatting to my posts for better readability and emphasis
stories.benefit: I can make my posts more engaging and easier to read through formatting
acceptanceCriteria: User can apply bold, italic, and strikethrough formatting
User can create bulleted or numbered lists
User can add headers or section breaks
Formatting controls are intuitive and visible during post creation
Formatted content renders correctly in the newsfeed

stories.title: Edit My Own Posts
stories.goal: edit my posts after publishing to correct mistakes or update content
stories.benefit: I can maintain accuracy and relevance of my content without deleting and recreating posts
acceptanceCriteria: User can access an edit option on their own posts only
Edit interface loads the existing post content with all formatting preserved
User can modify text, links, and formatting
Post displays 'edited' indicator with timestamp after updates
Edit history is tracked for moderation purposes

stories.title: Delete My Own Posts
stories.goal: remove posts I've created if I no longer want them visible
stories.benefit: I have control over my content and can remove posts that are no longer relevant or appropriate
acceptanceCriteria: User can access a delete option on their own posts only
System prompts for confirmation before deleting
Deleted posts are removed from the newsfeed immediately
Associated comments and reactions are also removed or archived
Deletion is logged for audit purposes

stories.title: Draft Posts for Later Publishing
stories.goal: save posts as drafts and publish them later
stories.benefit: I can compose posts over time without being forced to publish immediately
acceptanceCriteria: User can save a post as draft during creation
Drafts are stored and accessible from user's profile or post creation area
User can return to edit drafts at any time
User can publish drafts with a single action
Drafts are private and not visible to other users

stories.title: Post Character Limit and Validation
stories.goal: receive guidance on acceptable post length and content
stories.benefit: I understand content limitations and avoid wasting time on posts that won't be accepted
acceptanceCriteria: System enforces a reasonable character limit (e.g., 5000 characters)
Character counter displays remaining characters during composition
User receives clear error message if attempting to exceed limit
System validates content for prohibited elements (e.g., excessive special characters)
Publish button is disabled until validation passes

stories.title: View Post Engagement Metrics
stories.goal: see how many people have engaged with my posts
stories.benefit: I can understand which content resonates with the league and adjust my participation accordingly
acceptanceCriteria: Post displays count of comments and reactions
Author can see total view count (if tracking is implemented)
Engagement metrics update in real-time or near real-time
Author can click on metrics to see details (e.g., who reacted)
Metrics are displayed consistently across all post types
